scope: Workload-owned MLX Vulkan adapter for the exact pinned Parakeet joint.mlpackage

implementation.mil_order: cast decoder_state to fp16; cast encoder_frame to fp16; add; relu; fp16 linear; slice token [0:8193]; slice duration [8193:8198]; cast duration to fp32; cast token to fp32
implementation.execution: A scoped mx.stream(mx.gpu) covers constant transfer and every input-dependent operation without changing the caller's default device. Host work is limited to package parsing, full hash validation, immutable constant decoding, and transfer of constants into MLX arrays.
implementation.shared_loader: load_pinned_component(package_path, component) rejects symlinks and nonregular entries, reads each exact pinned decoder/joint package file once, validates length and SHA-256 on those immutable buffers, then parses the official MIL Block and snapshots named const outputs from the same buffers. It is not an IR or interpreter.

contracts: Loaded constants are immutable snapshots unaffected by later package mutation
Cached immediate constants cannot be made writable
Every physical package entry must be pinned, regular, and not a symbolic link
Model and weight parsing consumes the same immutable bytes whose length and SHA-256 were accepted

native_arithmetic_diagnosis.result: The authenticated float32 uploads, fp16 casts, fp16 add, and fp16 ReLU match the NumPy IEEE-fp16 reference bit for bit. Baseline equals an explicit fp32 dot rounded before fp16 bias and is the closest tested token result. mx.addmm equals fused fp32 dot-and-bias and is farther from native token logits. Rounded-fp16 products, a balanced fp16 tree, and sequential fp16 accumulation also do not reproduce the native tensors. The package and capture have no compiled compute plan or accumulator/reduction declaration, so source arithmetic remains unchanged.
